description: This file defines the TeamsMembershipsService class, which manages team membership operations such as creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and validation within a project. It interacts with repositories and other services to handle team membership logic.

classes.name: TeamsMembershipsService
classes.description: Service class for managing team memberships, including creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and validation logic.

methods.name: shouldAutoAccept
methods.description: Determines if a team membership should be auto-accepted based on organization and user email.

methods.name: createTeamMembership
methods.description: Creates a new team membership, possibly auto-accepting and updating event types.

methods.name: getPaginatedTeamMemberships
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of team memberships with optional email filtering.

methods.name: getTeamMembership
methods.description: Fetches a specific team membership by team and membership ID, throws if not found.

methods.name: updateTeamMembership
methods.description: Updates an existing team membership with new data.

methods.name: deleteTeamMembership
methods.description: Deletes a team membership after removing the user from the team.

methods.name: canUserBeAddedToTeam
methods.description: Validates if a user can be added to a team based on OAuth client associations.
